about: Records of the fix round of Task 35 (R59.3c): the urgent-path measurements for BOOKS_PER_STEP (ruling R142), the beacon against base with an A/A pair (ruling R137), the plain long-frame runs, the home-scroll cold and box-open cost films. Builds: base = the clean 3c66e39 build, baseAA = the same build served again on another port (the A/A control), one / two = 3c66e39 plus BOOKS_PER_STEP 1 / 2, beacon = 3c66e39 plus the counter beacon, after = the main tree's build (the two-books build in the confirm runs, the long-frame set "base vs after" with set name 2-books, and the final tree, three books, in the last long-frame sampler set). Every run is a fresh headless Chrome; builds alternated; load1_5_15 is the machine's load average at the start of the run (the owner's After Effects and Premiere Pro were running).
